findings.title: Release source-of-truth is bound to a stale revision
findings.evidence: 8c71412 is the immutable release/tag commit and origin/main at publication; 7d7aec57 is the later local documentation revision.
findings.suggestedFix: Separate release-candidate evidence from current documentation revision and refresh closeout evidence.

summary: Fresh closer rejected archive only because the documentation conflated the release candidate with the current local review revision.
